about: Site updates shown on /changes. One entry per working session, a sentence or two: changes within 2 hours of the newest entry's time go into it (and its time moves to now); otherwise a new entry goes on top. It does not have to cover everything. See CLAUDE.md.

updates.text: New riders get a two-minute setup that ends with a head-to-head top ten, adding credits works park by park with optional dates and ride counts, and Rank more makes ranking the rest easy. Sign-in is now accounts only. Rankings and the profile's top ten are now compact lists that open to show each coaster's global ranking. The site now opens in light mode, and opened coasters show where they rank among your rides by the same maker and model.
A day copied to a friend now shows in the feed a minute after the original.
Relocated rides now count as one credit with one page, search forgives typos and knows park initials, and the homepage and profile got tidier.
